title: GPT-5.6 arrives in Kiro for spec-driven software development
friendlyTitle: Kiro adds GPT-5.6 to structured coding workflows
summary: Kiro now offers GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna inside workflows that turn requirements into designs, tasks, implementation, review, and property-based tests. OpenAI says testing found Terra completed successful Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks in Kiro at roughly 82% lower cost, though that is a vendor-reported result.
friendlySummary: Kiro can now use three GPT-5.6 models to plan, build, review, and test software from clear requirements.
whyItMatters: The useful shift is not merely another model option: Kiro wraps models in explicit specifications and checkpoints, which can make agent-generated code easier for teams to review and govern.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Clear plans and review points can make AI-written code easier to check before it reaches users.
